t: The Ghola Project & the Vigilant Innovator: Building Sovereign Systems in the Age of AI
s: Advocates for declarative, reproducible system building using Nix/Guix, drawing parallels to science fiction, to achieve computing sovereignty by separating infinitely reproducible systems from unique data.
sub: Nix/Guix for declarative and reproducible system builds
Critique of Docker/Kubernetes overhead vs. Nix/Guix efficiency
Philosophical commitment to a single, robust build system ('Plan A')
Science fiction analogies for technological innovation and dogma
